meta.prompt_source: 用户提供题面：英语二大作文，图表为某高校学生每月参加志愿服务次数占比（从未参加 35%；1-2 次 45%；3 次及以上 20%）

band.rationale: 对照第二档描述逐条核验：本文图表三组数据（35%/45%/20%）全部覆盖、三段式结构完整、Firstly/Secondly/In my opinion 等衔接可用，符合第三档『基本完成了试题规定的任务』『包含多数内容要点』『采用简单的衔接手法，内容基本连贯，层次基本清晰』；但 10 句中约 7 句含基础语法错误（does not provides、activities is、make friend、the the），属『有一些语法结构或词汇方面的错误，但不影响理解』，达不到第四档『语言基本准确，只有在试图使用较复杂结构或较高级词汇时才有个别错误』的要求，也未恶化到第二档『影响了对写作内容的理解』，故定第三档。

dimensions.name: 切题与图表解读
dimensions.evidence: 35 percentage of students never join in volunteer activities, while 45 percentage of them take part in one to two times every month. Only 20 percentage students join three times or more.
dimensions.deduction_reason: 三组数据全部覆盖且数值正确、点了每月频率，切题；但 percent/percentage 连误三次拉低图表描述的精确度，且缺少一句总括（如'多数学生参与频率偏低'），描述停留在逐条报数。

dimensions.name: 内容展开与评论
dimensions.evidence: Firstly, some students think study is more important than volunteer work, so they spend all their time in the library. / It can help us learn skill and make friend.
dimensions.deduction_reason: 两个原因和评论段立场齐全，任务要点都在；但每个论点只有一句泛泛概括，无例子、无数据呼应，评论段收尾 Only in this way can we grow up better 属套话，展开深度不足。

dimensions.name: 组织与段落逻辑
dimensions.evidence: There are many reasons for this phenomonon. Firstly, ... Secondly, the school does not provides enough information about volunteer activities, many students don't know how to join.
dimensions.deduction_reason: 描述—原因—评论三段分工清晰（脚本段字数 47/45/43 均衡），Firstly/Secondly/while/Only in this way 构成基本衔接；扣分点在逗号粘连句把第二段两个论点挤在一起，句际逻辑靠堆叠而非连接词。

dimensions.name: 语法与句式控制
dimensions.evidence: the school does not provides enough information about volunteer activities, many students don't know how to join. / In my opinion, volunteer activities is good for students.
dimensions.deduction_reason: 主谓一致（activities is）、助动词后动词形式（does not provides）、逗号粘连、名词单复数（learn skill / make friend）、冠词重复（the the）五类基础错误几乎每段都有；句式以简单句为主，仅有 Only in this way 一处倒装亮点。

dimensions.name: 词汇与搭配
dimensions.evidence: 35 percentage of students / make friend / this phenomonon
dimensions.deduction_reason: 核心词 percentage 三次误用、phenomonon 拼写错误、make friend/learn skill 搭配不完整；join 与 take part in 低水平反复轮换，词汇面窄且重复。

dimensions.name: 格式与卷面
dimensions.evidence: The chart shows the situation of students taking part in volunteer activities in a university. ... In my opinion, volunteer activities is good for students.
dimensions.deduction_reason: 议论文格式完整、三段齐全；脚本字数 135、为建议下限 150 的 90%（soft_ok），按规则属小幅不足不罚分，仅提示写到 150 词左右更稳。

consistency.adjustments: 初评各维度 3.5+1.5+1.5+0.5+0.5+1=8.5，首次校验即落在第三档 7–9 区间内，未回退调整。

sentence_edits.original: The chart shows the situation of students taking part in volunteer activities in a university.
sentence_edits.issue: the situation of students taking part in... 偏中式直译且信息空泛，没有点出图表真正统计的是『参与次数』。
sentence_edits.revised: The chart shows how often students in a certain university take part in volunteer activities.

sentence_edits.original: 35 percentage of students never join in volunteer activities, while 45 percentage of them take part in one to two times every month.
sentence_edits.issue: percentage 不能直接跟在数字后面，35 percentage of 应为 35 percent of（或 35% of）；join in volunteer activities 搭配不地道，应为 participate in / take part in。
sentence_edits.revised: Thirty-five percent of the students never participate in volunteer activities, while 45 percent of them do so only one or two times a month.

sentence_edits.original: Only 20 percentage students join three times or more.
sentence_edits.issue: 20 percentage students 应为 20 percent of the students；join 后缺宾语，join 不能裸用表示『参加活动』，需写 join such activities 或改用 participate。
sentence_edits.revised: Only 20 percent of the students participate three times or more each month.

sentence_edits.original: There are many reasons for this phenomonon.
sentence_edits.issue: phenomonon 拼写错误，正确拼写为 phenomenon。
sentence_edits.revised: There are many reasons for this phenomenon.

sentence_edits.original: Firstly, some students think study is more important than volunteer work, so they spend all their time in the library.
sentence_edits.issue: 本句语法成立、衔接自然，可润色之处：think 后可补 that 更正式，all their time 略显绝对，改 most of their time 论证更严谨。
sentence_edits.revised: Firstly, some students believe that study is more important than volunteer work, so they spend most of their spare time in the library.

sentence_edits.original: Secondly, the school does not provides enough information about volunteer activities, many students don't know how to join.
sentence_edits.issue: 两处硬伤：助动词 does not 后必须用动词原形，provides 应为 provide；逗号不能连接两个完整句（comma splice），应加连词 so 或拆成两句。另外 how to join 后缺宾语，宜补 them。
sentence_edits.revised: Secondly, the school does not provide enough information about volunteer activities, so many students don't know how to join them.

sentence_edits.original: In my opinion, volunteer activities is good for students.
sentence_edits.issue: 主谓一致：主语 activities 是复数，is 应改为 are。
sentence_edits.revised: In my opinion, volunteer activities are good for students.

sentence_edits.original: It can help us learn skill and make friend.
sentence_edits.issue: 可数名词不能光杆单数：learn skill 应为 learn skills；make friend 应为 make friends。
sentence_edits.revised: It can help us learn practical skills and make new friends.

sentence_edits.original: The school should offer more chances and students should balance the the study and volunteer work.
sentence_edits.issue: the the 冠词重复（与预检脚本 repeated_word 标记一致）；balance the study 中 the 多余，应为 balance study and volunteer work；两个并列句之间宜加逗号。
sentence_edits.revised: The school should offer more opportunities, and students should balance study and volunteer work.

sentence_edits.original: Only in this way can we grow up better.
sentence_edits.issue: 倒装结构用得正确，值得肯定；但 grow up 多指儿童长大成人，与大学生语境搭配生硬，grow up better 读起来别扭。
sentence_edits.revised: Only in this way can we develop more fully.

improved_version:
The chart illustrates how often students in a certain university take part in volunteer activities every month. According to the data, 35 percent of the students never participate in such activities, while 45 percent do so only one or two times a month. Merely 20 percent join in volunteer work three times or more.

Several factors may account for this phenomenon. Firstly, many students regard study as more important than volunteering, so they spend most of their spare time in the library. Secondly, the university does not provide sufficient information about volunteer programs, and as a result, quite a few students simply do not know how to sign up for them.

From my point of view, volunteering benefits students in many ways: it helps them acquire practical skills, make new friends, and develop a sense of responsibility. Therefore, the university should offer more opportunities and publicize them better, while students should learn to balance study with volunteer work. Only in this way can campus life become truly rewarding.
top_problems: 基础语法错误高频：全文 10 句约 7 句含客观错误（does not provides、activities is、make friend、the the 等），主谓一致、名词单复数、助动词三块反复失守，是压住档位上限的第一因素。
图表核心词汇误用：percent/percentage 三次连错，join 与 take part in 低水平反复轮换，图表描述的精确度与可信度受损。
内容展开单薄：原因与评论各只给一两句泛泛论断，无例子、无数据呼应，结尾 Only in this way 套话收场，评论深度不足。
practice_advice: 每天写完一段后做三分钟'两查'自检：先圈出每个句子的动词及其前面的名词，核对主谓一致和可数名词是否带复数或冠词；再专查数字后的 percent（数字后只可用 percent，percentage 只用于 a percentage of 这类结构）与 does/do/does not 后的动词原形。把本文的 7 处 error 改正句各抄写一遍并口头复述原因，坚持两周可消掉最高频的三类错误。

patterns: The chart illustrates how often ... (主题) in a certain university.
X percent of the students never ..., while Y percent do so only one or two times a month.
Several factors may account for this phenomenon. Firstly, ... Secondly, ...
Only in this way can we ... (倒装收尾)
